# Skewness
Skewness is the property of a **[[Probability and Statistics Lecture 7#Random Variables|Random Variable]]** which gives us an idea about the shape of probability curve.\
The coefficient depends on 3rd because 
$$
skewness=\frac{\mu_3}{\mu_2^{3/2}}
$$

Depending on the value of coefficient of skewness
- $skewness>0\implies \text{The curve is positively skewed}$
- $skewness<0\implies \text{The curve is Negatively skewed}$

![Positive Skewness in Data and Its Impact on Data Analysis](data:image/jpeg;base64,)



# Kurtosis
Its the property of the **[[Probability and Statistics Lecture 7#Random Variables|Random Variable]]** that gives us an idea about the flatness of the probability curve.
$$
\beta_2=\frac{\mu_4}{\mu_2^2}
$$
Depending on the values
- $\beta_2 = 3 \implies$ The curve is mesokurtic
- $\beta_2 < 3 \implies$ The curve is platykurtic
- $\beta_2 > 3 \implies$ The curve is leptokurtic
